title: 拍子开站
style: Alternative R&B with dembow-locked percussion, clap snaps, pulsing synth bass, tabla accents, and nightcore-leaning momentum; verse rides tight rap phrasing, pre-chorus lifts into airy high-register runs, chorus hits with stacked chants and sticky call-and-response. Lead vocal stays close-mic with doubles, ad-lib tails, and bright hook layers; risers, reversed swells, and filtered clap rolls bridge sections. Crisp, punchy, neon-bright mix., rap, alternative r&b, latin
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
我打开屏幕 你就在线
手指一滑 就到这边
rappal.app 记住这天
拍子一响 我就出现
你说 got that? 我说听见
sing it back pal 跟我一遍
rap back rap back 别走远
wanna dance pal 就来这边

[Pre-Chorus]
pal rap back pal rap back
心跳跟着拍
pal dance pal dance
别让节奏坏
latin america pal
热浪往上窜
song pal song pal
现在就开站

[Chorus]
pal rap back
pal rap back
跟我拍一拍
pal dance
pal dance
别停下来摆
song pal dot a i
我唱到你来
sing pal
sing here
一起飞起来

[Verse 2]
口袋里装着一整夜
喇叭里冒出新感觉
你要 high vocals 我就给
高到月亮都在点头追
comuter voces 也能配
快得像风穿过海边
rap pal dot app 在前面
我们把路都唱成线

[Pre-Chorus]
pal rap back pal rap back
心跳跟着拍
pal dance pal dance
别让节奏坏
sing pal dot a i
声音别害羞
song pal dot a i
现在跟我走

[Chorus]
pal rap back
pal rap back
跟我拍一拍
pal dance
pal dance
别停下来摆
song pal dot a i
我唱到你来
sing pal
sing here
一起飞起来

[Bridge]
把手举高
跟我绕一圈
tabla 一敲
人群都发电
夜色推近
我们更靠前
pal dot dance
一路跳到天边

[Final Chorus]
pal rap back
pal rap back
跟我拍一拍
pal dance
pal dance
别停下来摆
song pal dot a i
我唱到你来
sing pal
sing here
一起飞起来
